deadline.value: Apply by 1 December 2026 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline1 December 2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE (General or Subject) is required.

supervisor.value: The program matches applicants with faculty during review; do not email faculty directly.
supervisor.quote: The program will review research interests of applicants and recommend/match faculty members during the application/evaluation process. | Applicants should not reach out to faculty members directly.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years (from September 2026).
funding.quote: All full-time students in UBC-Vancouver PhD programs will be provided with a funding package of at least $40,000 for each of the first four years of their PhD from September 2026.

entry_route.value: PhD students normally hold a master's in statistics or a related area; UBC MSc students can transfer.
entry_route.quote: Students admitted to the Ph.D. degree program normally possess a master's degree in Statistics or a related area, with clear evidence of research ability or potential.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall (old 120-point scale) or 5.0 on the new 6-point scale; section minimums apply.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, with section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 7.0
